name: Congressional Disclosure Tracker
urlBlockedBy: The *.demos.noeinsolutions.com wildcard A record does not resolve yet (NXDOMAIN from 1.1.1.1 on 2026-09-12). Publishing via hetzner-site will fail at HTTP-01 certificate issuance until it exists.
note: No sign-up. Read-only, data frozen 12 September 2026.
noteIt: Nessuna registrazione. Sola lettura, dati congelati al 12 settembre 2026.

data.refresh: python scripts/freeze_demo_data.py, commit the fixture, redeploy.

killSwitch.note: Unset or false and POST /api/demo/session 404s, the read-only middleware stands down and the banner never renders. Default off.

resets: Nothing to reset: every write to /api/* is refused while DEMO_MODE is on, so the snapshot a visitor sees is the snapshot the next visitor sees.
runLocally: python scripts/unpack_demo_snapshot.py && DEMO_MODE=1 CONGRESS_DB_PATH=data/db/demo-snapshot.sqlite APP_PASSWORD=demo python -m src.api
